rows.response_text: To politely cut a meeting, consider summarizing what has been discussed and focusing on a piece of the conversation that is relevant to the agenda. Additionally, one can ask follow-up questions to keep the discussion moving forward. It is also helpful to post a note outside the door stating the meeting's time beforehand to communicate the importance of attending on time. If someone is consistently late to meetings, perhaps they should reconsider committing to them in the first place.
